title: A year and a half at CWS
author: jerry-zou
text: On August 14, Justin emailed to say that CWS's Orange County office would close on September 4. After a year and a half with CWS, I am grateful to Justin, the staff, and the families who let me be part of their lives. These are a few records from that time: the closure email, a conversation at the office, and a call with Justin to go through a client interest form. Thank you for the patience, guidance, and friendships. I hope we stay in touch.
credit: Photographs and screenshots provided by Jerry Zou. Closure email from Justin Castillo, CWS.
